195796.overview:
Goldorak (also known as UFO Robot Grendizer, Grandizer, Ufo Robot Grendizer Raids, and Goldrake), is a Japanese manga and animated television series created by Go Nagai in 1975.

This is an original digital table created by ROM for Future Pinball, and later ported to Visual Pinball X by Javier1515.

196223.overview: Gork is a rare pinball machine manufactured by Taito (specifically Taito do Brasil) in 1982. The playfield design is heavily based on Gottlieb's 1973 machine, Sky Jump.

207398.overview:
In this monster-packed pinball adventure, players become Godzilla! The evil aliens, the Xiliens, use mind control rays to take control of the monsters King Ghidorah, Gigan, Megalon, Ebirah, and Titanosaurus. The Xiliens are demanding all of Earth’s resources. Godzilla and its allies, Mothra, Rodan, and Anguirus, battle the Xilien invasion with the goal of conquering Mechagodzilla to become King of the Monsters!

Chaos and destruction ensue on the playfield with Godzilla multiball, started by shooting one of the various shots in and through the centrally located skyscraper.  In the Premium and LE models, a motor actuates the skyscraper, diverting balls through each of its five stories as it collapses, ultimately locking three balls on its roof.  The Premium/LE playfield also features a collapsing bridge ramp. This animated breakaway ramp is guarded by a custom molded Godzilla and can divert pinballs back to the flipper or directly onto the playfield during Bridge Attack multiball.

On the Premium and LE models, Mechagodzilla features a motorized three-bank target set which rotates to reveal a spinner and jump ramp. Players will engage the Kaiju in battle by launching  pinballs with the jump ramp and bashing the magnetic ball catch on its chest to start Mechagodzilla multiball.

All models of Godzilla pinball machines feature an innovative “Magna Grab” magnetic newton ball, capable of catching pinballs from five different shot paths, including off the plunge. This device can also divert pinballs to set up shots from the upper left flipper. The game also includes the iconic title song “Godzilla” by Blue Oyster Cult, stunning hand-drawn artwork by Zombie Yeti, intricate wireform ramps, three spinning targets (Heat Ray, Mechagodzilla, and Monster Rampage), three flippers, three “powerline” themed stand-up targets and a UFO pop pumper. The game highlights video and audio from ten* Toho Showa Era Godzilla films to create a one-of-a-kind immersive Godzilla pinball experience.

208991.overview: Ghost Rider is one of the four Marvel pinball tables included in the Vengeance & Virtue DLC pack, released in late 2011 for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2, then ported to Pinball FX3 in 2017. The table is based on the 2006 Ghost Rider comic series, depicting stuntman Johnny Blaze's transformation into Ghost Rider, the "Spirit of Vengeance" who fights against villains alive and undead.

461908.overview: Galáxia is an extremely rare electromechanical space-themed machine released in 1975 by LTD do Brasil. Unlike many other Brazilian tables from this era, it is not considered a clone of any American-produced table.

461916.overview: Grand Prix (1977) by LTD do Brasil is a fast-paced racing-themed pinball table featuring looping shots, drop targets, and vibrant Formula 1 visuals. It captures the energy of 70s motorsport with smooth gameplay and classic solid-state charm.

468525.overview:
Garfield was originally released for Zen Pinball Party on Apple Arcade on December 9th, 2021. Inspired by the Garfield comics, the table features a variety of missions and multiballs - there's a lot more to Garfield's life than just sleeping and eating lasagna, after all.

Garfield was designed by Thomas Crofts. The table features similar rules to his My Little Pony table, where every shot corresponds to starting a mode, but there are a wider variety of modes in this table and not every mode is required to start the wizard mode.

468557.overview:
Guardians of the Galaxy is one of the three Marvel pinball tables that are part of the Cinematic Pack, released in 2014 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. Based on the 2014 Marvel Cinematic Universe film of the same name, directed by James Gunn and featuring characters from the 2008 incarnation of the Guardians of the Galaxy, this pinball table focuses on the Guardians of the Galaxy, a band of former galactic criminals, and their mission to stop the Kree extremist Ronan.

A few years after this table was released, Stern produced a physical pinball adaptation of the film.

468672.overview:
Get ready to experience the wildest pin-baaa-ll game, inspired by the absurdity of Goat Simulator 3! From headbutting bumpers to launching yourself through loops, every move you make will leave a trail of chaos behind.

Table features:

- Guide Pilgor to The Big Red Button and start a nuclear apocalypse
- Overcome the alien invasion by hitting little UFOs
- Attend Farmer’s Got Talent and impress all the judges with spectacular shots
- Take the Farmer’s tractor and launch it over the mini playfield jump ramp
- ! Battle against the villainous Farmer to escape his simulation in the Wizard Mode!

468985.overview: Delve into the world of Gloomhaven as mercenaries! Infiltrate the Inox Encampment, defeat Jekserah’s army of corpses among other adventures to enter the Void and confront The Gloom!

468986.overview: Use your pinball skills to prove Godzilla is the King of Monsters! Battle rival Titans, thwart the scheming of APEX, unleash your heat ray, and face Mechagodzilla in the ultimate showdown.

468987.overview:
Surviving your own fairy tale, brave knight, requires first reliving seven of the Brothers Grimm’s most classic stories. Find the seven dwarfs, awaken Sleeping Beauty, protect Little Red Riding Hood, escort Cinderella, and more. My, what big jackpots you have!

Table features:
- Destroy the Gingerbread House by hitting the captive ball
- Wake up Sleeping Beauty with the Coffin Sinkhole
- Watch out for the Angry Witch! She'll divert your balls and spill poison in your way
- Light up the TALE targets to complete your knightly attire and multiply your points
- Look in the Magic Mirror for random rewards
- Destroy the Witch's Castle in a 7-ball Wizard Mode
- Invite enough guests with the spinner to unlock a secret Wizard Mode

469021.overview: One will fall. Godzilla and Kong unleash their powers in this epic pinball table! Bring the fight to APEX Cybernetics and ultimately help the Titans join forces against Mechagodzilla.

469394.overview:
Explore the secrets of Granada! Intricate architecture and mysterious sounds bring this exotic Spanish table to life.

Produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in 1974, Granada is an electro-mechanical pinball machine that holds a unique place in the company's early history as an adapted clone of Williams' 1972 table of the same name. The Zaccaria version features a modified playfield layout and cabinet artwork taken from Williams' 1967 table 'Touchdown'. 

Zaccaria's Granada features the same artwork on the backglass and playfield as Williams' Granda; Zaccaria even reused Williams hardware and that is why the Williams logo appears on this game. Both the backbox insert and lower cabinet insert are stamped with the name 'Zaccaria', though the backglass has no apparent Zaccaria logo.

470512.overview:
Gargamel has decided to use another strategy to capture the smurfs. In the middle of the forest he has built an amusement park for the smurfs, and pretending to be nice he will try to capture them all. The smurfs are having too much fun, unaware of Gargamel and his intentions.

The goal of the game is to become a master of the 6 main rides/attractions. You'll find skillshots, ball savers, extra balls, mystery awards, highscores and much more. When you are a master of an attraction then each time you complete the attraction you get a jackpot. This jackpot increases each time you get the jackpot.

The Attractions:
- The Mirror Maze: a maze where you may end on the Azrael Shooting gallery, the bumper cars or simply back to the entrance.
- The Azrael Shooting gallery: just drop all the targets, don't forget to nudge!
- The Haunted House: hit all the targets and be careful of the ghosts.
- Bumper Cars: hit those 100 times to advance your status.
- Freefall: help your smurf friends to ride the freefall. Shoot the spinners.
- Ferry's Wheel: Papa smurf will help you to get you to the top playfield. Here you may ride the Main Center Ride or the Insane Ride.
- Insane Ride: hit the targets to increase the value of the ride, and get your three smurf friends and get your ride!

470571.overview:
Gorillaz are an English virtual band created by musician Damon Albarn and artist Jamie Hewlett in 1998. The band primarily consists of four fictional members: 2-D (vocals, keyboards, melodica), Murdoc Niccals (bass guitar), Noodle (guitar, keyboards, backup vocals) and Russel Hobbs (drums). Their universe is presented in media such as music videos, interviews, comic strips and short cartoons. Gorillaz's music has featured collaborations with a wide range of musicians and featured artists, with Albarn as the only permanent musical contributor.

This homebrew digital pinball table for Visual Pinball X was created by Zandy's Arcade in 2024. The table is full of the band's songs, and there are 15 different song modes to complete. Song modes are completed by following the lights on the table, and after completing a song mode, the next song will begin.

470580.overview:
• Do not play in direct sunlight
• Do not drink water while playing
• And above all never play after midnight

Gremlins is a remake of Gottlieb's 1987 pinball table "Victory" for Visual Pinball X, using artwork and audio from the 1984 comedy horror movie.

471035.overview: A homebrew table released for Visual Pinball X in 2025 based on Green Day's classic 1994 album Dookie.

471472.overview: Gremlins Mega Madness is an original virtual pinball table developed by ROM and Francisco666 for the Future Pinball platform, first released in 2012. It is a fan-made creation based on the Gremlins film franchise, known for its high-quality presentation and immersive atmosphere.

471639.overview:
Nightmare is widely considered the most challenging and atmospheric table in the classic 1992 pinball simulation game Pinball Dreams, developed by Digital Illusions. It is the fourth and final table in the set. Although listed as "Nightmare" in the menu, the playfield itself says "Graveyard." This inconsistency was addressed in some later ports, such as the Game Boy version, which renamed the table in the menu as "Graveyard".

The table is themed around a graveyard, ghosts, demons, and evil occurrences. It features dark, Gothic-inspired artwork with crosses, tombs, and eerie visuals, and it is known for having a very steep table design, making it difficult to keep the ball from moving quickly. The layout and some rules of this table are based on Williams' Terminator 2: Judgment Day pinball machine released a year earlier. 

The table is celebrated for having some of the best, most atmospheric music on the Amiga.

A 3D version for the Future Pinball platform was created by users Slash2084, Sebek74, Jerry Winter, and IamMrBongo.

472070.overview:
SLAMT1LT's version of Gorgar for Future Pinball keeps the layout and playfield of Williams' 1979 physical table but increases the horror factor with new sounds, new music, new effects, and new features to create a chilling and menacing atmosphere. 

The original Gorgar is known for being the first talking pinball machine with a vocabulary of just seven words; this version increases Gorgar's vocabulary with additional words recorded by SLAMT1LT himself.

472177.overview: A space-themed original table for Future Pinball by Roney Pinball. An updated version with FizX 3 physics was released by GeorgeH in 2025.

476176.overview: A fun and colourful original table for Future Pinball inspired by the classic 1981 arcade game, Galaga. Much like the arcade game, your goal is to destroy waves of 40 martians per stage. Progressing through the stages scales up the scoring potential and layout difficulty.

477244.overview: Galaxy: ULTIMATE Edition for Future Pinball adds suitable in-game music to Stern's 1980 early solid state classic.

477746.overview: Based on the Nicholas Cage action heist movie from 2000, Gone In 60 Seconds is an original table for Future Pinball by well-known developer ROM. It is essentially a re-theme of Stern's "Mustang" table from 2014, with different rules and gameplay. The objective is to collect all eight cars in the game, plus the final car, "Eleanor" (the GT500 Mustang Shelby).

480224.overview: Released for Future Pinball in 2013, "The Good, the Bad and the Ugly" is an original table by Jipar, derived from the 1966 Italian spaghetti Western film starring Clint Eastwood.

480225.overview:
The NitroNimbus mod of Jipar's "The Good, the Bad and the Ugly" table for Future Pinball updates the games' physics, and makes a number of visual changes. 

The playfield has been given a saloon-style wooden plank texture, rather than the grainy sand texture of the original; there is a more modern, attractive DMD; mini video clips taken from the movie are displayed under the DMD; the backglass artwork has been tweaked, with an added visual effect of being shot at and receiving bullet-holes at certain points during gameplay.

480677.overview:
Released in July 2012, Gravure Idol Pinball is an adults-only game for Future Pinball. The objective is to achieve all the 'Showtime' bonuses by getting three matching pictures in the center of the playfield. Players do this by hitting bumpers to change the picture reels, and then hitting specific drop targets to hold or unhold the picture reels.

For unskilled players, there is an option to press 0 to view 'Showtime' at any point in the game.

480915.overview:
Jipar's Ghostbusters table is a mod of Ruckage's "The Hungry Dead" for Future Pinball, based on the classic 1984 supernatural comedy film. It has no connection with Stern's physical Ghostbusters table from 2016.

Rules:

- Clear all white ghost-targets to begin 'ghosts massacre' = clear all ghosts within 1 minute to receive JACKPOT.

- Enter old house 4 times to start 'multiball' (All targets hit when in multiball mode increase jackpot).

- Call the 4 ghostbusters and Lock ball to start 'Ghost Hunt' (hit each Ghost as it pops up within 15 seconds). Mode ends if you fail to hit a target within the time limit. Score for succesful hit double each time, up to a maximum of 128000 per Ghost.

- Hit red target to raise the score. Receive currently lit score upon entering the haunted house.

- Enter GhostBusters' house (ramp) to clear all black ghost-targets and open the EXTRABALL gate on the top of the roof.
